model_hash.description:
blake3 hex of the canonical evaluated model (D19a): comment and
formatting edits do not change it.

components.description: Components in tree order (depth-first from the root body component).

engines.description:
Liquid engines and their feed systems (`engines/<id>.rw.toml`), SI,
with tank nodes resolved against their `tank` components (M4.4).

units.description: SI unit symbol per dimension name used in this document (`length` → `m`).

Reference.description: Reference dimensions used by aero and stability.

oneOf.description: Pure number (ratios, counts, coefficients). Bare numbers allowed.

DimKind.description: A named physical dimension, as written in `x-unit-dimension`.

containment.description: How this component sits in its parent.

aero.description: Participates in aerodynamics (external axial chain + surface components).

x_fore.description: Fore station (m from the nose tip).

radial.description: Radial offset of the component axis from the body axis.

EvalComponent.description:
One placed component. Its kind (`shape.type`) and SI shape parameters
are in [`EvalShape`].

oneOf.description: Inside a tube: rings, inner tubes, recovery, mass.
On the outer surface: fins, lugs, buttons.

offset.description: Body-frame offset `[x, y, z]` of this instance from the component placement.

Appearance.description: Renderer appearance (R2.5). Presets map to PBR materials.

oneOf.description: Fields shared by the planar fin sets.
Fields shared by the planar fin sets.

points.description: Planform `[x, y]` from the root LE.

oneOf.description: Fields shared by the planar fin sets.

height.description: Total height above the body surface.

base_height.description:
Base height at the body surface (source default `height / 4`;
0 when absent from older evaluated JSON).

flange_height.description:
Flange height at the outer face (source default `height / 4`;
0 when absent from older evaluated JSON).

oneOf.description: A spool: base (od, at the body), neck (id), flange (od, outermost).

EvalShape.description:
Shape parameters in SI, tagged by `type` (same spelling as
[`super::ComponentType`]). Hollow parts carry `id`; solid parts have `id = 0`.

members.description: Member component ids (axial chain plus contents).

overrides.description: Whole-stage mass/CG override (members' dry parts, motors excluded).

motor.description: Motor ref as written (`generic:RW_C6G`); resolved by the Session.

import.description: Import provenance of the motor (absent for authored configurations).

accept_substitution.description: The substituted generic curve is accepted (no `RW-W103`).

digest.description: The imported file's motor digest, when it has one.

MotorImport.description:
The motor an imported file (`.ork`) named for a mount, and how
`rw import` resolved it.

oneOf.description: A curve embedded in the imported file, copied into `lib/motors/`.
A curve from the local ThrustCurve cache, copied into `lib/motors/`.

No curve was available offline: the nearest built-in generic curve
by impulse class and diameter stands in.

MotorResolution.description: How an imported motor was resolved.

visual_flow.description:
`kind = "visual_flow"`: the evaluated study (absent for flights, so
flight sims hash as before).

wind_direction_deg.description: Direction the wind blows from, clockwise from north.

gravity.description:
Gravity model. Absent: the engine default (`wgs84`). Added after the
M1.5 freeze as optional, so older files and their hashes are unchanged.

launch_into_wind.description:
Point the rod into the wind (the rod azimuth follows the wind
direction). Absent: `false`. Optional for the same reason as `gravity`.

Conditions.description:
Launch and environment conditions. Shared verbatim by `EvalSim`,
`SimInput`, `RunManifest`, and the oracle golden, so its hash
(`rw_api::oracle::conditions_hash`) identifies a setup across all of them.
Units are in the key names.

oneOf.description: ISA with custom base temperature and pressure.
Classic RK4, fixed step (parity triage, D13).
WGS84 normal gravity at the site latitude, falling off with altitude.

tank.description: Feed node id of the tank shown (`None`: the oxidizer branch's tank).

EvalVisualFlow.description: An evaluated visual flow study (`[visual_flow]` in SI, defaults applied).

oneOf.description: A scripted rocking tilt (`tilt`, `swing`, `period`) on a static stand.

AttitudeSource.description: Where a visual flow study's attitude comes from.

needs_sim.description: The rule references simulation metrics; it runs only with `--sim`.

oxidizer.description: Oxidizer and fuel ids (`n2o`, `ethanol`, or a CEA species name).

EvalEngine.description:
One liquid engine in SI (`engines/<id>.rw.toml`, M4.4). Unset inputs stay
`None` and are reported as `RW-W21x` missing inputs.

pressure_drop.description: Injector pressure drop (given, or the fraction times chamber pressure).

station.description: Centre station (the tank component's mid-length when unset).

tank.description: Resolved tank geometry (from `component` or the inline `tank`).

EvalTankSpec.description: A tank's geometry, fill, and wall material in SI.

path.description: JSON pointer into the source model, e.g. `/c/fins/span`.

Diagnostic.description: One finding, phrased for an agent (`hint` says what to do next).
